verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents plugin marketplaces as catalogs for distributing skill-bearing plugins to others, with one-command registration, version tracking, automatic updates, and git or local-path sources. Plugins are described as built for sharing with teammates, and project-level `.claude/skills/` directories also exist. A hands-on probe installed an official skill into a project's `./.claude/skills/` straight from the shared GitHub repo, corroborating the shared-repo and project-files paths. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs stating that skills committed to the project repo automatically load for every teammate, and admin-enforced or managed distribution of a mandatory skill set.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: Sharing with teammates, distributing to community, versioned releases, reusable across projects
